_note: The eval card, in USD for each 1M tokens, keyed by the model that the Router names in the response (served, with no provider prefix). A call with the vendor usage.cost uses that figure. Each other call is priced by the card of its served model. A served model that is not here, or no served name, is priced at the most expensive rate of the card (spend.worst_card), and a run that meets a served model that is not here stops (TS-7a-cap, 2026-11-15). peak true: the DeepSeek peak bands double the call.

deepseek-v4-pro._note: Fitted on 2026-10-25 from four streamed calls through the production Router. The card reproduces each probe's cost within 1 percent. completion_tokens counts the reasoning tokens.

deepseek-flash._note: Input and output are the Flash list prices (0.30 and 1.20 at peak, so half off peak, and the peak factor applies on top). The cache-hit rate is DeepSeek's off-peak list price (0.006 at peak), from https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing/ on 2026-10-30.

claude-haiku-5-5._note: The Console provider registry (provider_registry.py, Anthropic). The pilot of 2026-11-15 reproduces the usage_event bill of 54 calls with it. The cache-hit rate is one tenth of the input rate, the Anthropic list ratio. No pilot call had a cache hit, so that rate is not checked.

claude-sonnet-5-5._note: The Console provider registry. The pilot of 2026-11-15 reproduces the usage_event bill of 3 email-assistant calls with it. Cache hit: one tenth of the input rate, not checked.

claude-opus-5-5._note: The Console provider registry. Not checked against a bill. It is the most expensive model of the card, so it sets the price of an unknown model.
